title: Week 7-ish of creating an explorable island with AI
author: MogensenJ
selftext:
Hi all!

  
Here's a quick look at my first attempt at making a game with the help of AI, week 7 or so.

This project started as a vague test of what Claude could make with a few prompts, and escalated into a whole explorable island with visuals I consider semi-decent.

# What's in it

**Play mode**: you play as an orb with the goal of gathering energy scattered throughout the map. That's it. There's no other game mechanic yet, as I focused on visuals first. It's boring but also kind of fun to just roam around and see the day/night cycle in action 😄

**Map editor**: as I found the procedurally generated map (by Claude) too limiting so I started working on a full blown map editor in which I can sculpt, paint/generate biomes, place and paint props, and more.

**Model optimizer**: I started optimizing the model geometry, as well as generating LOD variants with KTX, via the commandline. Since that's kind of cumbersome, I created a UI that streamlines the whole process for this. Pretty handy!

# Workflow

**Coding**: Pretty simple. My main driver for this is Cursor. I started out with a set of game-related skills my agent found to guide the development, but abandoned these rather quickly when the project started to take shape. Most of the time it's just prompting and seeing what happens. There's an instruction in my rules that tells the agent to run tsc & biome before presenting its work, preventing the most blatant errors.

**Models**: most models are currently sourced from sketchfab, but I started creating some of them manually:

1. Create a model visual with GPT-image (2.5), tweak it to the bare minimum (so no fine details), make the background white.
2. Feed that image to Trellis v2, export the model as GLB
3. Feed the GLB to GPT-6 Astra with the task of cleaning it up
4. Make GPT-6 Astra create foliage and other textures atlases (also GPT image 2.5) and fit them to the base model
5. Make Astra reduce the triangle count, export it again
6. Optimize + creating LOD variants via the custom made **Model optimizer**

# What's next?

I'm not sure! Currently I really enjoy enhancing the visuals and little details, step by step. The project underwent several overhauls, and I try to dive deep into each new feature instead of half-assing it (which AI models tend to do hehe). So, building slowly and steady. Mainly slowly 😄

I'm really curious what you think about this! Any ideas are much appreciated!

comments.author: Wunddorn
comments.body:
Wow, I like your map editor!
What are your plans for the future of the game?

replies.author: MogensenJ
replies.body:
Thanks! I'm not sure yet, at the moment I'm postponing game mechanics by working on the visuals haha. The initial idea was this: you play as a memory of a god, gathering energy, finding a settlement with followers, expanding your influence, etc. Up to a point where you control whole planets, etc.

That, or a simple exploration game à la Firewatch. Suggestions are welcome!

replies.author: Wunddorn
replies.body:
Sounds cool.
Alternative you could go more or less the same way, but using a slime as the MC.
It could absorb all kind of stuff and gain new abilities, like shape shifting, transformation into other beings, all kind of magic...
You could take the anime "That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime" as an inspiration.
